title: Associativity for summand-normalized ringed tensor comparisons
statement: Let (C,J,R) and (D,J′,R′) be arbitrary ringed sites with the sheafification hypotheses of [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], retaining independent site and coefficient universes. Let U be an additive functor on their module-sheaf categories, ν a natural tensor comparison satisfying ordinary inverse associativity, and δ the corresponding natural comparison on total cochain tensors satisfying the total-summand equation. For three source complexes P,Q,N and model associators aB,aA on their source and U-image triple, assume the local pure-triple generator formulas. Then U_complex(aB) ; δ(P,T(Q,N)) ; T′(1,δ(Q,N)) = δ(T(P,Q),N) ; T′(δ(P,Q),1) ; aA. No preservation of internal Hom or derived representative assertion is assumed.

source.place: Tags 03EL, 06YU and 0FPT; tensor associativity on total-complex summands.

proof.text: Use local pure-triple detection to identify both supplied model associators with the native complex associators. Install the canonical sheaf monoidal structures and expand total-tensor and summand aliases. Apply the abstract model-chain associativity theorem with the ordinary inverse associativity and total-summand formulas. This is solely a chain-level statement.

lean.statement:
theorem ringed_tensorComparison_associativity
    (ν : @MonoidalCategory.tensor _ _ (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R) ⋙ U ≅
      (U.prod U) ⋙ @MonoidalCategory.tensor _ _ (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R'))
    (hν : letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
      letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R'
      ∀ X Y Z, (ν.inv.app (X, Y) ▷ U.obj Z) ≫ ν.inv.app (X ⊗ Y, Z) ≫
        U.map (α_ X Y Z).hom = (α_ (U.obj X) (U.obj Y) (U.obj Z)).hom ≫
          (U.obj X ◁ ν.inv.app (Y, Z)) ≫ ν.inv.app (X, Y ⊗ Z))
    (chain : coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R ⋙ U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
      ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod (U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))) ⋙
        coefficientTotalTensor.{s, d, vd} J' R')
    (summand : ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (RingedTensorModules.{c, v, r} J R) ℤ)
      (p q n : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = n),
      U.map (coefficientTensorSummand.{c, v, r} J R P Q p q n hpq) ≫ (chain.hom.app (P, Q)).f n =
        ν.hom.app (P.X p, Q.X q) ≫
          coefficientTensorSummand.{d, vd, s} J' R' ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
            ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) p q n hpq) :
    RingedTensorComparisonCoherence J R J' R' U chain
